text:
Elena: Hi all, first week here! I'm about to open my first PR to adjust an HTTP header in the serving runtime. Quick checklist Qs: branch naming conventions, reviewer etiquette, and which CI failures I should treat as hard blockers vs flaky that we re-run?

Kevin: Welcome aboard! Branching: `feat/<yourname>/<short-desc>` for features, `fix/<yourname>/<short-desc>` for fixes. Base branch: `main`. Try to keep PRs focused (ideally <400 LOC).

Sam: Local prep: run `pre-commit run --all-files`, `make test` or `./scripts/test.sh` for a fast runtime smoke. We require pass on linters, mypy, and unit tests  those are hard blockers.

Oliver: CODEOWNERS auto-suggests reviewers. Runtime changes usually pick me and @sarah (`./runtime/**`). If it touches the public API, ping @Kevin explicitly. Infra/ops changes -> @eng-infra.

Jen: For user-facing changes, add a short "Docs" section in the PR body and update `CHANGELOG.md` under Unreleased if needed.

Kevin: CI: must-pass jobs are `lint`, `mypy`, `runtime-smoke`. Flaky candidates are `integration-db` and `perf-smoke` (timeouts occasionally). If only flaky jobs fail, comment `@eng-oncall can you re-run?` and request a rerun; don't merge until required ones pass.

devex-bot: Heads-up: PR footer needs DCO signoff (Signed-off-by: Your Name <email>) or the bot will request changes. Link a ticket or include context (we accept `/no-ticket` but add rationale).

Elena: How do reviewers prefer to be requested? GitHub reviewers + Slack ping?

Sam: Add GitHub reviewers in the sidebar, then drop the PR link in #devex with a 1-line summary, e.g.: `Elena: PR https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/456 - small runtime header tweak, needs 1 reviewer`. If urgent, add :rotating_light: and tag oncall.

Oliver: Use Draft while iterating. Set reviewers to 1-2 people and add a `size/*` label (`size/S`, `size/M`) so it's easier to triage. If you touch deploy or infra configs, ping me.

Elena: Great, thanks. I'll push `feat/elena/runtime-header-tweak` and follow the checklist.

Kevin: One more tip: include a tiny reproducer or logs in the PR description if it's behavioral; saves back-and-forth.

Elena: Will do, appreciate the help!
